recipe.eligible: all rows within valid native hard-single pool, irrespective of correctness
recipe.decision: Sort all rows per category by entropy and tie-break; remove affordable prefix with cost <= tau + tolerance; update n_c after each removal.
recipe.audit_cost_semantics: The cost and n_before_deletion for rank j assume all earlier-ranked rows in the category were removed. Beyond the selected prefix these are hypothetical costs; the last row has null cost and cannot be removed.
recipe.correctness_usage: Stored for reporting only; not used to select removal candidates.
